title: Art By Committee: Wind
content: On previous Wednesdays,hereandhere, we’ve played a game called “Art By Committee,” where I give you an excerpt from an actual science fiction manuscript, and then you have a week to illustrate it.Here’s an example from the original Art-By-Committee sketchbook. Please click on the image to enlarge.The new excerpt for you is: “A wind—not moving air but currents of force—rose up and tore at her.”Tomorrow: Krøyer’s Hip Hip Hurra!
